simple.meaning: תָּפַף (tâphaph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to drum , i.e. play (as) on the tambourine.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Psalms, Nahum, beginning at Psalms 68:26. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תָּפַף (H8608) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תָּפַף (tâphaph) / H8608 is traced through Psalms 68:26, Nahum 2:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.
